implemented_source: Stdlib immutable private journal with closed bounded canonical JSON, content identity, no-clobber link publication, actual file/directory fsync, exact idempotence and conflicting-byte refusal.

Stable revision filename from repo_root,state_path,canonical_task_cid,board_namespace. Attempt ordinal, display alias and board digest cannot create a new key. Changed immutable provenance at that key refuses rather than returning absence.

Strict owned0700 unaliased journal directory and owned0600 single-link regular records; bounded population256 and record64KiB; unknown entries, pending temporaries, hard links, symlinks, malformed/noncanonical JSON or directory replacement fail closed.

Coarse state-lane denial independent of later ordinals. Empty read returns None, never a grant/token/lease. A read-only owned canonical lifecycle namespace preflight stops after 4096 entries before calling the original strict inventory, then verifies stable namespace afterward; at most 256 verified quarantine receipts are supported.

Source-owned OriginalDispositionScope accepts actual installed original modules, exact PortalImplementationDaemon and original lifecycle store, current PID/thread and bounded source pins including this helper.

Actual task revision derivation uses original PortalTask and original identity producer plus exact original legal board bytes. Original attempt binding checks actual state type, consumed counters by display ID/CID, active exact lifecycle capture/current process birth and exact loaded original record.
Failure journal publication and read-only joining of an existing actual original strict lifecycle quarantine receipt. Joining returns denial diagnostics while keeping the original borrow retained.

stable_public_apis.input_contract: Actual installed original modules and exact current original objects, not paths or projected class names as authority. Source pins must include both actual original module files and this helper.
stable_public_apis.meaning: Binds source/PID/thread/object association only; creates no journal directory and grants no cleanup, state transition, native lease or connection ownership.
Derives canonical task revision using the original producer and exact legal board hash. Returns denial metadata only.

Read-only coarse original lane gate. Reads all bounded matching journals and always inspects original strict quarantine inventory even if the journal directory is absent. A matching denial, malformed/unreadable storage or inconsistent source raises before caller productivity. Absence is not admission.
stable_public_apis.scope: The supported single-ordinary-attempt original state lane is wholly deferred if any revision associated with its state path is parked. This version does not pretend every independent task writer is integrated.

stable_public_apis.meaning: Retains actual references and checks original current-state/consumed-ordinal/lifecycle association. Does not prove original borrowed database connection or physical native stopped custody; the actual retained host must supply those independent checks before any journal publication.

Publishes an immutable deny-only failure journal in the preexisting, originally charged private state subdirectory. Never refunds attempts, raises caps, invokes quarantine or marks implementation finished.

Returns exact already durable denial provenance for the existing original deny-only quarantine API. The dictionary is never lifecycle or scheduler authority. A later original caller must use module.QUARANTINE_REASON as the fixed quarantine reason; detailed original failure stays in reason_code.

Reads the original strict receipt for the actual captured workspace, checks exact lifecycle/authority association and all original denial flags, and reports observed parking IDs with original_borrow_retained=True. It neither publishes quarantine nor closes borrowing.
Low-level real filesystem deny storage for the source-owned wrapper and privateFS tests. Supplied JSON never substitutes for original daemon/state/lifecycle/connection/native objects.

storage_and_crash_boundaries: Caller creates and charges state_path.parent/report-only-attempt-dispositions as an owned0700 directory before dispatch; helper does not create arbitrary parent paths.

Publication writes a fresh owned pending file, fsyncs its content, links without replacing the final revision name, unlinks only the same owned temporary inode and fsyncs the directory. Concurrent/conflicting final bytes are preserved.
A crash before temporary removal can leave a pending entry or a two-link target. Both fail closed on read; no automatic unlink, overwrite or absence inference occurs.

A directory-fsync failure after link preserves final bytes and reports uncertainty. An explicit finite deny-only retry of exact bytes may fsync the existing directory; no provider retry or new native grant follows.

The read-only gate is not an atomic global admission transaction. Supported host orchestration must serialize original attempt/disposition production. Broader concurrent writers require a separately reviewed lock/entry integration contract.
Original quarantine receipts are immutable deny metadata, not reconstructed live authority after process death.
